en: Heheheh... It would appear that{SAUT}all our actors are present.
Ah, this?{PAGE}Well, this is a rare opportunity for{SAUT}me. Etiquette demands I wear the{SAUT}proper attire.
But you're not our enemy, Theodore.{SAUT}Fighting you just feels wrong...
Please, do not let that bother you.{SAUT}After all, this is no mere fight―{SAUT}it is a formal bout.{PAGE}Let us battle with no hard feelings.{SAUT}I shall be giving this my all as well.
Hmhm... I confess I'm relieved to{SAUT}see you've warmed up to the idea,{SAUT}Theo.
Perhaps we simply have a natural{SAUT}inclination to this sort of thing.

We preside over power. Normally, we{SAUT}simply observe as you walk your path...{PAGE}But the stronger you grow, the more{SAUT}we feel a certain hunger... to battle{SAUT}you, and taste your power ourselves.{PAGE}My sister's command certainly surprised{SAUT}me, but now I realize... I long for{SAUT}the thrill of battle.
Whoaaa... That line was straight out of{SAUT}a postgame superboss monologue!{SAUT}Is this, like, Omega Theodore!?
Now, let us begin. Please, hold{SAUT}nothing back.
Yes. Allow me to bear witness to{SAUT}the full scope of your power.
Well then. Let us begin once again.{SAUT}I will be expecting great things...
